holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Standalone net profit for Q2 FY27 reached ₹14,843 crore, reflecting a 20.1% increase, while consolidated profit stood at ₹16,333 crore.
The CASA ratio declined 340 bps to 36.1% alongside an increase in FCNR (B) deposits.
Fixed deposit rates were raised up to 7.30% for senior citizens, and select savings account transaction charges were scheduled for revision from December 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest position at 3.89%. Although the stock rose 4.04% over the past month, it recorded a 3-month decline of 2.7%, directly influencing fund-level returns within its 29.4% financials allocation.

watch.text: The implementation and customer impact of revised savings account cash transaction charges starting December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: The proposed Jio Platforms IPO was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening.
ICRA reaffirmed RIL's AAA/Stable rating for non-convertible debentures and assigned AAA/Stable to ₹50,000 crore of bank facilities.
In Q1 FY27, sales were ₹309,468 crore and net profit stood at ₹23,196 crore with an operating profit margin of 15%.

holdings.why_it_matters: Reliance carries a 2.47% fund weight and was among the bottom 3-month detractors, delivering a -6.89% return and shaving an estimated 0.170% off portfolio value.

watch.text: The completion of the Jio Platforms IPO listing and its impact on debt servicing costs and financial flexibility.

holdings.name: TD Power Systems Ltd

what_changed.text: The company raised ₹600 crore through a Qualified Institutional Placement, alloting 77.42 lakh shares at ₹775 each.
June 2026 quarterly revenue rose to ₹640 crore with net profit reaching ₹86 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.31% weight, TD Power Systems served as the second-largest positive contributor over 3 months, posting a 15.46% return and adding 0.357% to the portfolio despite a 1-month correction of 16.02%.

watch.text: Market reaction and institutional participation following the completion of the ₹600 crore equity dilution.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional Q2 FY27 updates showed net advances of ₹5,77,094 crore and deposits of ₹6,51,491 crore.
The Reserve Bank of India approved Anup Kumar Saha as Managing Director & CEO for three years starting January 1, 2027.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.22% portfolio weight, the stock added 0.264% to fund performance over 3 months with an 11.89% return, helping balance lagging positions in the financial basket.

watch.text: Approval and release of unaudited Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results at the board meeting on October 24, 2026.

holdings.name: The Karnataka Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Chief Operating Officer Raja B S resigned effective October 19, 2026, after roughly 37 years of service.
The bank introduced 'Nava Dhamaka 2026', rolling out nine digital, payments, wealth, and lending offerings.
Gross NPA improved to 2.58% and Net NPA decreased to 0.87% in the June 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.11% of the fund, the bank gained 7.88% over 3 months, offering a positive push to the financials segment even as 1-month returns dipped 12.04%.

watch.text: Board consideration of Q2 and half-year FY27 unaudited results scheduled for October 28, 2026.

holdings.name: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

what_changed.text: A new wholly owned subsidiary, MCX Mineral Exchange of India Limited, was incorporated on October 16, 2026.
Internal key managerial personnel shifts saw Rashmi Nihalani moved to Head–Strategy and Training and Chittaranjan Rege moved to Head–Strategic Corporates and Research.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 1.99% of fund assets, MCX gained 10.63% over 3 months, generating an estimated 0.212% contribution.

watch.text: The board meeting on November 3, 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year FY26 unaudited results.

holdings.name: Coforge Ltd

what_changed.text: Q2 net profit grew 13% sequentially to ₹588 crore, accompanied by 11% sequential revenue growth.
The company increased its full-year EBIT margin guidance to 16% on the back of a 45% increase in order book.

expected.text: Reported Q2 earnings figures missed consensus estimates despite higher margin guidance.

seeing.text: Net profit reached ₹588 crore alongside a 45% expansion in order book, yet reported Q2 numbers trailed street estimates.

holdings.why_it_matters: Coforge delivered the highest 3-month return among major holdings at 28.01%, providing the top positive contribution of 0.546% to the fund at a 1.95% portfolio weight.

watch.text: Integration progress of Encora and realization of the 45% order book growth into revenue.

holdings.name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd

what_changed.text: Ontario authorities completed the dissolution of indirect subsidiary Yachiyo Canada on October 14, 2026.
Motherson Technology Services USA was assessed a penalty of USD 19,500 by the New York State Workers' Compensation Board.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 1.91% of fund assets within Consumer Discretionary (12.8% of portfolio), the stock gained 4.2% over 3 months after a 20.66% gain over 6 months.

watch.text: Consolidated Q2 and half-year FY26 results scheduled for review by the board on November 5, 2026.

holdings.name: Tata Steel Ltd

what_changed.text: The company commissioned ₹9,067 crore of facilities at its Kalinganagar plant.
The NCLT Mumbai Bench sanctioned the scheme of amalgamation of Rujuvalika Investments Limited into Tata Steel.

expected.text: Market commentary indicated expectations of a quarter-on-quarter EBITDA decline for Q2 FY27.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding an allocation of 1.84%, Tata Steel was a key 3-month drag with a return of -8.21% (contribution -0.151%), compounding 6-month losses of -20.18%.

watch.text: Q2 and half-year FY27 financial results consideration by the board on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: SBI reported an unauthorized cyber intrusion exposing 3,897 customer records on the dark web, while confirming customer balances remained safe.
In the June 2026 quarter, revenue stood at ₹136,240 crore and net profit rose to ₹25,121 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.80% portfolio weight, SBI's 3-month return of -5.56% and 6-month drop of -12.94% detracted from fund performance within the dominant Financials allocation.

watch.text: Remediation and potential regulatory follow-up regarding the dark web exposure of customer data.

portfolio.statement: HSBC Flexi Cap Fund is anchored in Financials (29.4%) and Industrials (20.2%), where strong tech and mid-sized industrial gains were tempered by microfinance, NBFC, and heavy materials weakness.
interp: Technology and niche industrial names drove fund gains, led by Coforge (+28.01%) and TD Power Systems (+15.46%).
Underperformance in non-bank financial names, CreditAccess Grameen (-31.40%) and Shriram Transport Finance (-13.94%), along with Reliance (-6.89%), curbed broader portfolio returns.
portfolio.line: Top performer Coforge (+0.546% contrib) balanced out losses from CreditAccess Grameen (-0.436% contrib) over 3 months.

drivers.text: Coforge raised full-year EBIT margin guidance to 16% on a 45% surge in its order book.
TD Power Systems raised ₹600 crore through an allotment of 77.42 lakh shares via QIP.
Jio Platforms opened an IPO that was fully subscribed within 100 minutes, though Reliance shares hovered near 52-week lows.

themes.title: Private Banking Leadership
themes.text: Large banking positions are navigating net interest dynamics, with ICICI reporting 20.1% profit growth and Kotak recording robust provisional credit and deposit expansion.

themes.title: Capital Raising and Expansion in Industrials & Materials
themes.text: Key holdings are scaling operational capacity, as TD Power completed a ₹600 crore QIP and Tata Steel brought ₹9,067 crore of facilities online at Kalinganagar.

macro.why: Banks are adjusting savings fees, term rates, and navigating shifts in CASA mixes.
Incidents involving customer record leaks on the dark web present operational and reputational concerns for major financial institutions.

priced_in.text: Strong operational demand and order intake for Coforge, whose shares gained 28.01% over 3 months.
Equity dilution from TD Power Systems' ₹600 crore QIP completed at ₹775 per share.

could_change.title: Q2 FY27 Earnings Delivery Across Financials
could_change.text: With board meetings scheduled across Kotak Mahindra Bank, The Karnataka Bank, and MCX, asset quality trends and loan growth figures will dictate sector momentum.

could_change.title: Jio Platforms Listing and RIL Deleveraging
could_change.text: The successful completion and eventual listing of Jio Platforms could alter debt servicing metrics and financial flexibility for Reliance Industries.

portfolio.risk_note: A 29.4% allocation to Financials leaves the fund vulnerable to credit cost shifts, deposit repricing pressures, and operational security hurdles across both private lenders and state-owned banks.
